text: Mobile app development is an exciting field with important decisions to make. One key choice is between native apps, built separately for each platform, and cross-platform apps, which use one codebase for both iOS and Android. Native apps often offer better performance, while cross-platform development saves time and money. Responsive design is also essential, so apps look good on different screen sizes. After development, you must publish your app on app stores like Google Play or the App Store, where it needs to meet strict rules. Finally, performance matters a lot: users expect fast, smooth apps, so testing and optimisation should never be ignored.
